dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: I sometimes have to face dangerous enemies when I'm out in the mountains gathering herbs. Like those greedy-gut Treasure Hoarders, or a boar in a bad mood.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: I know that not everywhere is gonna be as peaceful as the place where I grew up with my mom and dad. And Master won't always be there to protect me.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: That's why I practice the spear, even though I don't really like it. It's so I can drive those pesky varmints off all by myself!
